by Becky Cummings 


What turkey actually loves Thanksgiving? Wobble the turkey sure does! ♥ Especially when he finds out Farmer Joe will be “having him for dinner!” He can’t wait to be the dinner guest on this most special day.
As Farmer Joe sharpens his ax and prepares, Wobble prepares too. He styles his gobbler. He practices his loud, joyous gobbles and gets to bed extra early.
Meanwhile his friends on the farm do not share his excitement. Wobble can’t understand why!
How will dinner turn out for Wobble? Find out in this adorable story that captures the true meaning of Thanksgiving
